description: Colombo Municipal Council - Notifying that the Budget of Colombo Municipal Council for 2017 will be open to public inspection from 02.12.2016 to 09.12.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the public inspection period for a municipal council budget, which falls under public sector administration and service matters. It involves a local government body (Colombo Municipal Council) making its budgetary process accessible to the public, which aligns with Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) covering public sector services, administrative circulars, and public administration procedures.
